text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On our way back from an outing with Bubble Gum Fellow,
we were walking toward the station, but...
choice_data_list: Sorry. Looks like I missed a turn back there.
I'm sorry. Looks like I made a wrong turn somewhere.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, don't worry.
I think if we turn right over there, we should be able to get back—

text_block_list.name: Spiky-Haired Boy
text_block_list.text: Ah~, dammit! I fell again!

text_block_list.name: Spirited Girl
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, so close! Listen, alright?
Watch the bag's movement carefully, and keep your knees soft...

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Hmm...?
Hey Trainer, wanna take a quick peek?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Reaching the open square past the alleyway,
I saw flashy-looking boys and girls struggling to balance
what looked like beanbags on the tips of their toes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sensing the rough atmosphere among the young boys and girls, I instinctively try to turn back,
but Bubble Gum Fellow walks forward unbothered.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, that looks fun!
So we strike a pose... without dropping
that ball... thingy?

text_block_list.name: Spiky-Haired Boy
text_block_list.text:
Who are you, lady?
No unauthorized personnel allowed. Shoo, shoo!

text_block_list.name: Spirited Girl
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, hold on a sec.
You interested in footbag? Wanna give it a shot?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
It's called a footbag.
Yeah! Teach me how to play!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While I worried trouble might break out,
Bubble Gum Fellow naturally blended into their circle,
balancing the sphere they called a 'bag' on the tip of his foot.

text_block_list.name: Spirited Girl
text_block_list.text:
From that stance, kick the bag up
and catch it with your toes!
............That's the basic movement!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I see!
Kick it up, and catch it with the toes—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Spiky-Haired Boy
text_block_list.text: Ahahaha! You're so terrible at this~!

text_block_list.name: Spirited Girl
text_block_list.text:
Well, practice makes perfect.
Even for me, until I could consistently pull off a toe stall, it took days of—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I see. It doesn't fly as far as I thought, so it needs delicate control, huh...?
Hmm, hmm! In that case—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After juggling the bag on her toes a few times,
Bubble Gum Fellow kicked it high into the air with all her might.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Take that!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She catches the falling bag right on the tip
of her toe. Kicking it back up, she cushions it
with the inside of her foot, then the outside.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: I'm getting the hang of it! One more time!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Next came catching with crossed legs,
catching after a full spin,
catching while sidestepping...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Controlling the footbag with footwork unbelievable for a beginner,
she pulled off one trick after another.

text_block_list.name: Spiky-Haired Boy
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Whaaat!?
You're already that far ahead!? Are you a genius or something!?

text_block_list.name: Spirited Girl
text_block_list.text:
Are you really a beginner?
I honestly feel like I should be asking you for tips instead!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, I watched you guys doing it from outside,
you see. I just threw in some random tweaks,
but I'm glad it worked out!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I just had an idea!
How about something like this? Does the move have a name?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Bubble Gum Fellow walked while juggling her bag on her toes.
And just as she balanced on one foot—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Backflipping, she kicked the bag high into the air.
After spinning once more like a top,
she caught it on her toe and struck a pose!

text_block_list.name: Spiky-Haired Boy
text_block_list.text: Sooooo awesooomeee!!

text_block_list.name: Spirited Girl
text_block_list.text:
"You're way too pro!!
Sorry for mouthing off before.
Please let me call you Master from now on!!"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: You're exaggerating. Hehe, I can show you how it's done. First, kick your bag as you walk—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Ah~, that was fun!
It's nice to take a path you don't normally walk every now and then!
choice_data_list: Maybe so. I'm glad you enjoyed the bubbles.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When faced with the kind of person you don't usually deal with,
you'd naturally tend to shrink back, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Bubble Gum Fellow's brightness, confidence,
and the effortless dexterity with which she handles everything
have the power to captivate many.
choice_data_list: That was truly a magnificent feat!
Bubble's popular wherever she goes, huh
Bubble's popular wherever she goes, isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Bubble Gum Fellow's brightness, confidence,
and the effortless dexterity with which she handles everything
have the power to captivate many.
choice_data_list: That was truly a magnificent feat!
Bubble's popular wherever she goes, huh
Bubble's popular wherever she goes, isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Thanks!
I just tried it out thinking it'd be fun, but
if you're happy with it, that's what matters most!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
After all, if I'm gonna do it,
I want to leave a lasting impression.
I'll try another big move if I get the chance!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What kind of surprises would Bubble Gum Fellow offer us in the future?
It was a day that left everyone eagerly anticipating what was to come.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
You think so?
I think I'm just blessed to have great people around me.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I'm just doing what I want to do.
I'm just glad you see it in a positive light!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was simply due to how well-liked she is, but...
today was a day that reaffirmed Bubble Gum Fellow's
charisma in winning everyone over to her side.
